{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### Runtime Vulnerabilities (Node.js, Python, OpenVPN, KEV)｜執行環境弱點（Node.js、Python、OpenVPN、KEV）

`jt-runtime-vuln` · rules 133200-133299｜規則 133200-133299

補上 Wazuh 弱點告警的三個缺口：列在 CISA 已知遭利用弱點目錄（KEV）中的弱點一律升為 level 12 並寄出（原本 High 只有 level 10、不會寄出）；弱點資料尚未評分的弱點改發 level 7，原本完全不產生告警；並把每台 agent 的 Node.js、Python、OpenVPN 與 nodejs.org、python.org、OpenVPN 自己的發行資料比對，少了安全性版本或分支已停止支援，發布隔天就回報，不必等 CVE 資料。另外偵測 Node.js 與 Python 程序當掉。

Closes three gaps in Wazuh's vulnerability alerts: any finding listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue becomes level 12 and mailed (a High one was level 10 and never mailed); a finding the feed has not scored yet becomes level 7 instead of producing no alert at all; and every agent's Node.js, Python and OpenVPN is compared with nodejs.org's, python.org's and OpenVPN's own release data, so a missed security release or an end-of-life line is reported the day after release, without waiting for the CVE feed. Also Node.js and Python process crashes.

Discover query｜在 Discover 使用的查詢:

`rule.id:[133200 TO 133299] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-runtime-vuln · About｜說明","type":"markdown"}
